column3: Once the miasma's gone, they're all really nice people!
Yup! Mr. Vampire and Mr. Wizard aren't enemies. And neither are my friends!
That's all I came to say. Bye-bye!
Let's see... The study, maybe? I might find something there. I'd better head back to the manor.
Then they should calm down and might be willing to help you out.
No, no. It's still bothering me. To the study!
I could just keep going, but...
Rushing won't help. I should look around more carefully first.
They'll give you hints and sell you dress materials.
So if I destroy the bordermoons...?
Huh? Not enemies? Are you trying to tell me these monsters are on our side?
But right now, I'm more curious about Father's research.
No. Haste makes waste, as they say.
You know, not everyone in the labyrinth is an enemy.
Thanks for stopping by! Make yourself at home.
Thanks for stopping by! Make yourself at home.
No. I need to ask Mikhail about the genomroid!
Right. Let's hurry down to the basement laboratory.
No. I have to find out what it is. The genomroid!
Thanks for stopping by! Make yourself at home.
I've got some rare goods in stock, too. Do have a look.
Thanks for stopping by! Make yourself at home.
Good grief, there's no helping you sometimes. Please try to be careful.
W-well, er... You just wouldn't wake up, so...
I-I know, okay? I'll be careful next time, so can you drop it?
Whatever, I don't have time for this now, But you'll regret it later.
Please don't worry me like that...
Milady, please don't do be so reckless.
Please be more careful from now on.
Did you just smack me awake?
I will. By the way, Mikhail...
Oh, that's right. I was attacked by a monster in the labyrinth...
Oh, right. I got careless again, didn't I?
I told you over and over to be careful, and you still...!
This place is dangerous Alice, let's get out of here.
Huh? Where are you going, Alice?
Even if we run, we'll never get away! So I'm going! I have to go and beat him!
I see. Then go. Just be sure you make it back safely.
Got it Father! I'll remember that!
Even with the holy sword, a head-on attack won't leave a scratch on him.
I'm going to go defeat Varuudanu again!
So you're going after all? To face him once more?
His shoulder! Aim for its shoulder! There, surely...!
Don't say a word. I'm just glad you're safe.
I see, I cant't stop you. Very well, go Alice.
What? You've done enough. There's no need to push yourself any further!
Yes. I checked earlier, they should work just fine...
O Lord, O Heaven, grant this girl the strength to live once more.
O Lord, O Earth, reveal Thy boundless power here and now.
Hurry, milady! Use the holy sword to rescue the professor!
I won't stop you, but please be more careful from now on!
Sigh. There's no helping it. Please be careful this time.
It seems there are countless sewing rooms throughout the labyrinth.
I know, I know! Well, I'm off.
Don't shout. I'll be careful next time, so let's drop it, shall we?
O Lord, grant this girl the strength to live once more.
O Lord, descend from the heavens and reveal Thy power.
Right, I know! Leave it to me!
But where am I supposed to make a dress?
I was prepared for the revival ritual this time, but...
Huh? Really? And those sewing machines actually work?
There's no guarantee it'll go so well next time!
Now then, take care, milady. And do be careful this time.
Oh, I went and did it again, didn't I?
I've told you over and over to be careful, but you still...!
Thank goodness you're awake. You're safe.
I've got the bible. Better find the other sacred item fast.
